items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: I didn't know him. I didn't know that much of him.

ctx.x: Red didn't say anything, you know. So anyway, this fellow come in from New Orleans and joined Russell's band. And Russell's band at that time was real tight. I mean, Lee... Everybody knew one another and knew what was going to happen. If one of the fellows was going to make a curve(?) this way, everybody could feel it -- this-that-and-the-other, you know? And here comes Lee Collins with a big build-up from New Orleans, a young fellow, nice young man... And anyway, he started playing. He was going to take Red's…
